settings.amount_unit: agorot (integer); shekels appear only on the wire
settings.encoding: multipart/form-data on every Grow call — JSON bodies are silently not parsed

required_env_vars.label: x-api-key
required_env_vars.description: מפתח API. חובה מאז עדכון השרת של GROW (08/2026)

optional_env_vars.description: חובה בפרודקשן — מונע חיוב דרך מסוף בדיקה

notes: paymentLinkType must be 2 — value 1 renders a dead payment button (GROW support, 31/08/2026).
paymentTypes[0][type] is the literal string "payments"; numeric codes fail with err.id 427.
There is no cancelUrl in this schema — successUrl only.
Payer name and phone are not pre-filled; Grow's hosted page collects them from whoever pays.
Required after every successful payment, best-effort by Grow's own definition: the transaction is processed even if this call fails.
Both identifiers are required; sending one fails with err.id 54 naming the other.

webhook.verification: sender IP allow-list (https://developers.grow.business/reference/ip-address); webhookKey where the format carries one
notes: Grow does not send webhookKey on PaymentLink callbacks (support, 08/2026).
Callback keys arrive bracket-flattened (data[transactionId]) — read through flattenBracketKeys or every field is null.
Status values include Hebrew ("שולם", "בוטל"); anything unrecognised is treated as failure, never as paid.
